sloka: अहो स्वप्नस्य सुखता या ऽहमेंव चिराहृता ।प्रेषितं नाम पश्यामि राघवेण वनौकसम् ।। ५.३४.२०।।।।
transliteration: aho svapnasya sukhatā yā 'hameṁva cirāhṛtā ।preṣitaṁ nāma paśyāmi rāghaveṇa vanaukasam ।। 5.34.20।।।।

translations.english: "Oh I have been seeing the person sent by Rama in my dream for a long time. This is a pleasant dream to me.
